fusions.name: Run It Down
fusions.desc: Runs you to a target up to 7 tiles away and drags it down in a mesh, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold at Bay
fusions.desc: Locks onto a target at or below 30% health and holds it in the mesh, dealing 20 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Fetched Back
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: At Heel
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second and slowing each one it bites by 20% for 2 seconds.
